## graphical diagonotics of margins

### BPOT margins
```{r,echo=FALSE}

ci_sim(x0,pot) * exposure_day * 356 #all crash frequency predicted ci
# observed ci
c(1/14 * qchisq(0.025,df=2),1/14 * qchisq(0.975,df=2))

tt1 <- log_M$m1
tt2 <- log_M$m2

# CI marginal parameters BPOT
ci(tt1,type='parameter')
ci(tt2,type='parameter')

# graphical diagnostics of margins
plot(tt1)
plot(tt2)
```

### CBPOT margins
```{r,echo=FALSE}
# GP margins CBPOT
ci(pot,type='parameter')
plot(pot)
# Gamma margin CBPOT
confint(conseq)
plot(conseq)
```

## Copula plots
```{r,echo=FALSE}
emp_cop <- empCopula(cop_dat,smoothing="beta")

contourplot2(emp_cop, dCopula, nlevels = 20, main = "Empirical Copula")

contourplot2(frank_M$Cop@copula, dCopula, nlevels = 20, main = "Theoretical frank Copula")
contourplot2(clayton_M$Cop@copula, dCopula, nlevels = 20, main = "Theoretical Claython Copula")
contourplot2(gaussian_M$Cop@copula, dCopula, nlevels = 20, main = "Theoretical Gumbel Copula")
contourplot2(gumbel_M$Cop@copula, dCopula, nlevels = 20, main = "Theoretical Gumbel Copula")
```
